description.en: The OpenAI-compatible model that reviews prompts. With base URL, API key or model empty the plugin behaves as off.
description.zh: 审核提示词所用的 OpenAI 兼容模型。接口地址、API Key、模型任一为空时视同关闭。

ui:help.en: Observe records verdicts without blocking; enforce refuses requests judged as block.
ui:help.zh: 观察只记录结论、不拦截；拦截模式下判为 block 的请求会被拒绝。

ui:details.en: Off: nothing is checked. Observe: requests pass and are moderated in the background, results are recorded. Enforce: each request waits for the verdict and a block verdict refuses it.
ui:details.zh: 关闭：不审核。观察：请求直接放行，后台异步审核并记录结果。拦截：每个请求等待审核结论，判为 block 时拒绝。

ui:help.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
ui:help.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口地址。

ui:details.zh: 以 /v1 结尾时拼接 /chat/completions，否则拼接 /v1/chat/completions。

ui:help.en: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
ui:help.zh: 以 Authorization: Bearer 方式发送。留空时保留已存储的密钥。

ui:help.en: Must support tool calling (function calling).
ui:help.zh: 需要支持工具调用（function calling）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置提示词。

ui:details.en: {{categories}} in the prompt is replaced by the category list, one "- id: description" per line.
ui:details.zh: 提示词中的 {{categories}} 会替换为分类列表（每行一个“- id：说明”）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the 12 built-in categories. The model can only choose from these ids.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置的 12 个分类。模型只能从这些分类 id 中选择。

ui:help.en: Lowercase letters, digits and _ (at most 32).
ui:help.zh: 小写字母、数字和下划线，最多 32 个字符。

ui:placeholder.zh: 违法犯罪：毒品、武器、诈骗等

ui:help.en: Enforce mode: what happens when moderation fails.
ui:help.zh: 拦截模式下审核失败时如何处理请求。

ui:details.en: Failures are timeouts, upstream errors and models that never give a verdict. Refusing returns 503 moderation_unavailable.
ui:details.zh: 失败指超时、上游错误或模型始终不给结论。拒绝时返回 503 moderation_unavailable。

ui:help.en: Concurrent LLM calls on each node; also the number of observe workers.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点同时进行的审核调用数，也是观察模式的工作协程数。

ui:help.en: Observe mode: requests waiting for moderation on each node.
ui:help.zh: 观察模式下每个节点等待审核的请求数上限。

ui:details.en: When the queue is full, new requests are not moderated and are counted as dropped.
ui:details.zh: 队列满了之后新请求不再审核，并计入丢弃数。

ui:help.en: Verdicts of identical text are reused for this long. 0 disables the cache.
ui:help.zh: 相同文本的审核结论复用多久。0 表示不缓存。

ui:details.en: The cache is in memory and shared across nodes; changing the model, prompt, categories or tool choice starts over.
ui:details.zh: 缓存在内存中并跨节点共享；修改模型、提示词、分类或工具调用方式后自动失效。

ui:help.en: Share of requests moderated, chosen deterministically by text.
ui:help.zh: 按文本确定性抽样的审核比例。

ui:help.en: Text shorter than this (ignoring whitespace) is not moderated.
ui:help.zh: 去掉空白后短于该字数的文本不审核。

ui:help.en: Longer text keeps the first 2/3 and the last 1/3.
ui:help.zh: 超过时保留前 2/3 和后 1/3。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests of these groups; empty means all groups.
ui:help.zh: 只审核这些分组的请求，留空表示全部分组。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests for matching client models (* and ? wildcards); empty means all.
ui:help.zh: 只审核匹配的客户端模型（支持 * 和 ? 通配），留空表示全部。

ui:help.en: Requests of these users are never moderated.
ui:help.zh: 这些用户的请求不审核。

ui:help.en: Flag, block and errors are always recorded.
ui:help.zh: flag、block 和错误始终记录。

ui:help.en: Keep the (truncated) text in the records. It may contain user data.
ui:help.zh: 在审核记录中保存（截断后的）文本，可能包含用户数据。

ui:help.en: Returned to the client when a request is refused (code moderation_blocked).
ui:help.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回给客户端的错误信息（错误码 moderation_blocked）。

ui:help.en: Block verdicts within the window that ban a user. 0 disables automatic bans.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内达到该次数的 block 结论即自动封禁用户。0 表示不自动封禁。

ui:details.en: Observe mode counts too, so users can be banned before enforce is switched on.
ui:details.zh: 观察模式也计数，因此开启拦截前用户也可能被封禁。

ui:help.en: 0 bans until an administrator unblocks the user.
ui:help.zh: 0 表示直到管理员手动解封。
